subject: Aligning private deployment anchoring and service band‑mapping
messages:
From: Ben James <ben.james@sierrahealth.org>
To: hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai
Cc: procurement@sierrahealth.org
Date: Sun, 16 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Private deployment commercial questions — SKU anchoring and support bands

Hannah —

Thanks for the demo last week. Our procurement team reviewed the draft term sheet and we have a few specific points to clarify before we move to legal:

1) Platform fee amortization: do you support spreading the platform fee over a 24‑month invoice schedule for on‑prem pilots? If so, how does that interact with usage overage billing?
2) SKU mapping: we need a clearer mapping between "node seats" and "operator licenses" + edge nodes for our multi‑site rollout. Can you provide a simple matrix we can share with our infra team?
3) Support tiers: your doc lists Standard / Priority / Enterprise. What's included in Priority vs Enterprise SRE response windows, and can we cap on‑call hours?
4) Credits for migration: given this is a multi‑site proof‑of‑concept, is Redwood able to provide implementation credits tied to a 6‑month milestone?

Attached: an excerpt of our RFP that shows expected deployment topology.

We'd like a short written reply (one page) that we can attach to the procurement packet. Happy to hop on 30 minutes if it's easier.

— Ben James
Head of Procurement, SierraHealth
ben.james@sierrahealth.org
(415) 555‑2291

From: hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>
To: Ben James <ben.james@sierrahealth.org>
Cc: priyom_das@redwood.ai, naomi_feldman@redwood.ai
Date: Sun, 16 May 2027 13:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Private deployment commercial questions — SKU anchoring and support bands

Ben —

Thanks for the clear list — very helpful. High level responses below; I'll have Priyom attach the SKU matrix and Naomi to confirm SRE windows. If that looks good we can convert to one‑page language for your packet.

1) Platform fee amortization: We support amortization over 12/24/36 months. For a 24‑month schedule we invoice monthly against the amortized platform fee; usage overages are billed monthly separately and are not netted against the amortization. We can show an example 24‑month invoice schedule (see attachment RDW_SKU_matrix_v2.xlsx).

2) SKU mapping: Priyom will send a compact mapping for node seats vs operator licenses and edge node counts. We provide a per‑site anchor price and scaling factors for additional GPUs.

3) Support tiers: Priority includes 8x5 response with a 4‑hour P1 acknowledgement; Enterprise includes 24x7 with a 1‑hour P1 acknowledgement and an assigned technical lead. Both tiers include quarterly health reviews; Enterprise adds tailored runbooks and 2 days/month of incident assistance. We can cap on‑call hours into the SOW (typical cap: 40 hours/month) — Naomi, please confirm our standard cap language.

4) Migration credits: We can offer implementation credits tied to milestones for pilots. For a 6‑month proof‑of‑concept we typically offer a one‑time credit equal to 10–15% of the platform fee (dependent on committed nodes). Priyom will propose the exact credit schedule in his note.

Next steps: Priyom will respond with the SKU matrix + amortization example; Naomi will write the one‑page condensed language. If you prefer, I can schedule a 30‑minute call Tue/Wed to run through.

Best,
Hannah Schmitt
Head of Strategic Accounts (North America)
Redwood Inference
hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai

From: priyom_das@redwood.ai <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
To: Ben James <ben.james@sierrahealth.org>
Cc: hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai, naomi_feldman@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 17 May 2027 10:26:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Private deployment commercial questions — SKU anchoring and support bands

Ben —

Following up with the compact SKU matrix and a proposal for crediting. I've attached RDW_SKU_matrix_v2.xlsx which includes two pages: "Anchors & Scale" and "Invoice example (24mo)". Highlights below for quick copy into your packet: 

- Anchor configuration (recommended pilot): 2 operator licenses + 2 worker GPU nodes (A100 equivalent), 1 edge aggregator per site — Anchor list price: $120,000 platform fee (one‑time, amortizable).
- Scale factors: Additional worker node = $16,000/platform (annualized), additional operator seat = $9,600/platform.
- Amortization example (24 months): Monthly amortized platform fee = $5,000/month; usage overages billed monthly as metered tokens. Sample invoice in spreadsheet shows combined rows.
- Migration / implementation credits: For a 6‑month POC we can provide a milestone schedule: 5% credit at kickoff, 5% credit at pilot acceptance, up to an additional 5% for successful multi‑site cutover (15% maximum). Credits apply to platform fee only and expire if contract terminates within 12 months.
- Support band mapping (concise):
  • Standard: 8x5 email + business‑hour phone; P1 acknowledgement 12 hours.
  • Priority: 8x5 phone + 4h P1 ack; quarterly review.
  • Enterprise: 24x7 with 1h P1 ack; assigned TAM; 2 days/mo incident assistance.

A couple of optional flex items we can include in the packet to help procurement: a) Short‑term pilot discount — 10% off platform fee for first 6 months (applies only to the amortized portion), b) Deferred initial invoice — push month‑1 amortized invoice 30 days after kickoff. Both are one‑time asks and would be scoped to the deal id RDW‑1973.

Links: HubSpot deal (internal): https://app.hubspot.com/deal/678901
DocuSign sample SOW: https://app.docusign.com/envelope/123ABC

If this looks good I can produce the one‑page commercial summary and sample SOW language for legal.

— Priyom Das
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
priyom_das@redwood.ai

From: Ben James <ben.james@sierrahealth.org>

Cc: procurement@sierrahealth.org, priyom_das@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 19 May 2027 15:34:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Private deployment commercial questions — SKU anchoring and support bands

Hannah / Priyom —

Thanks — that matrix and the amortization example are exactly what we needed. Procurement will accept the 24‑month amortization and the proposed credit schedule, subject to two quick asks before we loop in legal: 

1) Can the pilot 10% discount be conditional and expire automatically after 90 days unless the POC is extended? We prefer automatic expiry mechanics.
2) For invoicing we need the initial invoice deferred 30 days after kickoff and a net‑45 payment term for the first two invoices while internal approvals close.

If you can confirm those two items in writing, I'll ask our legal team to prepare a short SOW and route it for signature. Procurement contact is procurement@sierrahealth.org — I've cc'd them so they have the attachments.

— Ben
Head of Procurement, SierraHealth
